messages:
nora: did a quick a11y pass on the new keyboard hints feature. found three issues: tooltip hints aren't keyboard-accessible (you have to hover), the hint text contrast is low on light theme, and the live announcer isn't announcing when a hint appears. attaching a tiny gif: https://assets.redwood/hints/keyboard-hint.gif :mag: ben: thanks - agreed. keyboard-only users must be able to trigger hints via focus or a dedicated key. are the hints currently implemented as CSS :hover only? sam: yep, they're hover-based. markup is `
?Quick tip
`. no focusable trigger. olivia: quick fixes: make the trigger a button with `aria-describedby` pointing to the tooltip id and expose it on focus-visible. Example: ```
Use Shift+Enter to run
``` also ensure tooltip visibility toggles on focus/blur and keydown (Esc to close). nora: good. contrast: tooltip bg #f8fafc with text #6b7280 -> ~3.2:1. needs >=4.5:1 for small text. propose tooltip text color #374151 or bump bg to slightly darker. ben: prefer darkening text to #1f2937 for safety. also use `font-weight: 600` and 14px for readability. a11y-bot: automated scan (axe) flagged: 4 violations - color-contrast (1), keyboard (1), aria-roles (1), aria-allowed-attr (1). details: https://ci.redwood/axe/1801234567 sam: announcer: we currently append the tooltip to DOM but don't update any live region. add a polite live region that receives the tooltip copy when it's shown. Keep it visually hidden. Example: ```
// on show: document.getElementById('hint-live').textContent = 'Tip: Use Shift+Enter to run'; ``` use requestAnimationFrame trick to ensure re-announcement if same text repeats. olivia: one more microcopy/aria nit: if the trigger is a button with `aria-describedby`, add `aria-expanded` when the tooltip is considered a disclosure, and `aria-controls` pointing to the tooltip id. for purely transient tooltips role=\"tooltip\" is fine, but for more content consider role=\"dialog\" + focus management. nora: timeline: ben will update visuals (contrast + weight); sam will update markup to button + live announcer; olivia will add keyboard handlers + ARIA attributes. aim for PRs today. i'll run VoiceOver + NVDA check after merge. ben: I'll also include a visual regression screenshot for tooltip focus state in both themes. sam: noted. i'll add a tiny unit that asserts `#hint-live` text updates on show so we don't regress. olivia: small follow-up idea: add a keyboard shortcut cheat-sheet accessible from the Help menu and ensure it's reachable by keyboard and announced by screen readers. tiny win for discoverability. nora: agreed that's a great follow-up. thanks all :sparkles:
